what: OPERATOR CORRECTION 2026-09-22, and it is the layer-2 check that is actually worth having: 'the roster is not a behaviour-observable fact, it is a LIST-observable fact... Just because something's not trading doesn't mean it's not on the roster -- it could just be sidelined. The only problem we would notice is if we see something trading that's NOT on the roster.' [!] SO THE CHECK IS AN INVERSE ANOMALY DETECTOR, NOT A CONFIRMATION: alert when a leg NOT on an account's list closes a trade on it. That is a positive assertion, it needs no positive control, and it fires on the case that matters. The confirmation direction cannot work at this trade rate anyway -- MEASURED over the 200 most recent closed trades (closedAt 2026-09-13T20:55:29Z -> 2026-09-22T08:48:49Z, ~9 days): 199 paper, 1 real money. [!] E31 (PR #12738) built LAYER 4, which detects that the process and the FILE have diverged. This row is the different question: whether what the system ROUTES has diverged from the list it holds. Both are named in docs/reference/verifying-what-is-trading.md; only the first is built.
